Native from [[Talhovi]], '''House Mekuun''', also known as the '''Shuttered House''', was one of the [[Ancient Houses]] that originally settled the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region. House Mekuun's holdings were in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]]. At the end of the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Crimson Days]], the House dissolved itself, and sought to reconstitute itself as a sector of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

The Mekuun family apparently owned the [[Mekuun Corporation/Legends|Mekuun Corporation]]. It was allied with [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren's]] plot in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].
